summary: The only grammar flag is a parser error (adjective read as participle); re-reading finds no restricted construction and the most idiomatic Dutch of the three versions ('Lag … rond de', 'in handen krijgen', 'in zijn achterhoofd', 'een weekje vrij'). Open points are lexical: the stretch budget is spent on the wrong words (binnenbrengen, koers in a new sense), the arbitrage gloss repeats the word, 'hopen' is a homograph the tool passes for the wrong sense, and b034 fronts a 12-word subject.

findings.problem: binnenbrengen is the third unglossed stretch (B1) lemma against a budget of 2, and in Dutch it means bringing something into a building, which is not the point here; a known-word rendering exists.
findings.evidence: checks: binnenbrengen stretch B1, action gloss-or-replace; stretch budget 2 already spent on schommelen and koers
findings.required_fix: `Neem een ton zilver mee.` (meenemen A1, as in V1/V2).

findings.fragment: Uiteindelijk kon niemand die koers nog houden.
findings.problem: koers is stretch (B1) and the reader, if they know it, know it as 'course'; the exchange-rate sense is new and unglossed, so 'die koers houden' is read as 'stay on course'.
findings.evidence: lexicon: koers stretch B1, en 'course of action, approach'; no gloss in b029
findings.required_fix: Either gloss: `kon niemand die \gl{koers}{exchange rate} nog houden`, or use known words as V2 does: `kon niemand de vaste prijs van een Galjoen nog vasthouden`.

findings.problem: The gloss repeats the word and tells the reader nothing; arbitrage is unknown and not transparent even in English.
findings.required_fix: `\gl{arbitrage}{arbitrage: profit from price differences}`. Once the gloss explains the term, the b031 parenthetical '— prijsverschillen op de markt weghalen —' can be dropped (see L11).

findings.problem: hopen 'heaps' is a homograph of hopen 'to hope' / hoop 'hope'; the tool counts it as known only for that sense. An A2 reader hesitates; a known synonym costs nothing.
findings.evidence: lexicon: hoop known A2 en 'hope'; hopen known A2 en 'to hope'; no 'heap' sense
findings.required_fix: `De enorme bergen gouden munten` (berg A2, as V1/V2) or `stapels` (A2).

findings.fragment: De enorme hopen gouden munten in de kluis van de familie Potter moesten ondertussen wel genoeg zijn
findings.problem: Legal but heavy: a 12-word subject phrase precedes the finite verb in a 23-word sentence; the reader holds the whole noun phrase before learning what is said about it.
findings.evidence: 23 words, > soft limit 20; subject NP of 12 words before 'moesten'
findings.required_fix: Split as V1: `Intussen lagen er in de kluis van de familie Potter enorme bergen gouden munten. Die moesten wel genoeg zijn voor zijn behoeften op de korte \gl{termijn}{term}.`

findings.problem: primitief is hard (B2) but glossed and a transparent cognate carrying Harry's contempt; acceptable as is.
findings.required_fix: None. (ouderwetse is the A2 fallback if the gloss count ever matters.)

findings.problem: Vocabulary rows dismissed: elk is known A1 (tool POS mismatch), gemene is the known A2 adjective gemeen.
findings.evidence: lexicon: elk known A1 [ADJ, PRON]; gemeen known A2

findings.fragment: Telkens als je geld wilde uitgeven, moest je zelf naar binnen en munten uit je kluis halen.
findings.problem: L-FRAME 9>8 dismissed: the span is inflated by the coordination 'naar binnen en … halen' under one modal; 17 words, one subordinate clause, reads naturally.
findings.evidence: flag L-FRAME dismissed; V1/V2 have the same sentence without 'zelf' at 8
findings.required_fix: None. If a shorter frame is wanted: `moest je zelf naar binnen. Daar haalde je munten uit je kluis.`

findings.problem: 'term' alone is ambiguous in English (semester, word); the phrase is what the reader needs.
findings.required_fix: Optional: `\gl{op de korte termijn}{in the short term}`.

findings.fragment: voor meer zilver dan je in het begin had
findings.problem: Comparative clause after dan (verb-final) is not in restricted.md; light, A2-textbook pattern. Accepted.
findings.evidence: allowed.md A-CMP-DAN lists phrase comparisons only

findings.fragment: De fijne details van arbitrage — prijsverschillen op de markt weghalen — begreep hier waarschijnlijk niemand.
findings.problem: Bare-infinitive parenthetical between subject and verb is the heaviest sentence of the scene; it is currently the only real explanation of arbitrage because the b029 gloss is empty.
findings.evidence: 6 words inserted between subject and finite verb
findings.required_fix: After L3: `De fijne details van arbitrage begreep hier waarschijnlijk niemand.`

findings.problem: schommelen (B1) is a precise verb for 'fluctuating' and the context ('op en neer' is not needed) makes it readable; a good use of the stretch budget. Note for the bible.

flag_decisions.reason: Inflected adjective gemeen (A2), not a participle.

flag_decisions.span: moest je zelf naar binnen en munten uit je kluis halen
flag_decisions.reason: Span is two coordinated predicates under one modal; 17 words, one als-clause, natural. One word over the soft limit only because of 'zelf'.

tool_feedback.reason: Lemmatiser returned 'gemene' as VERB; it is the adjective gemeen with -e.
Lexicon has elk known A1 with pos [ADJ, PRON]; spaCy tags 'Elke' as DET, so _pos_match fails.

'hopen' (heaps) passes as known via the verb hopen / noun hoop 'hope'; sense-blind homograph. Hard to fix in general; at least the lexicon entry for hoop could list 'heap, a lot' so the translator sees the ambiguity.
Status stretch is right, but the en hint 'course of action, approach' is not the sense used; the hint should carry all common senses or the tool should mark sense-ambiguous lemmas.
en hint 'to come in, to move in, to get closer' is wrong for the transitive 'bring in'; the action gloss-or-replace was nevertheless correct.
Separable 'Wissel … om' resolves to wisselen (A1); the particle verb omwisselen is not in the lexicon. Transparent in this scene, but the mechanism hides new particle verbs in general.
Accepted as achter+hoofd; the idiom 'in zijn achterhoofd' is transparent enough, recorded only so the rule's behaviour on idioms is visible.

2 of the 6 unknown tokens are the elk/gemene false positives; corrected share is 285/289 = 98.6%, which passes. New-lemma density falls to 3 real lemmas (schommelen, koers, binnenbrengen) = 10.4/1000; after L1 it is under 10.
Coordinated predicates under one modal inflate the span; V1/V2's identical sentence without 'zelf' scores 8 and is not flagged.
